fx.source: Toman per USD from AvalAI estimated_cost (2026-10-03, see IUST GPU Server and AvalAI - Resources and Costs), not re-measured on 2026-10-07; 1 Toman = 10 IRR. Arvan bazaar prices imply 2.6M IRR per USD for Claude/DeepSeek/Gemini lines (2.1M for older GPT-5 lines), so the single rate is an approximation for ArvanCloud.

extraction.why: Cheapest strong long-context model for KG and LightRAG extraction (USD 0.113 in / 0.382 out). Pilot it against deepseek-v4.1-flash on the gold triples. qwen3.7-flash on the same endpoint is cheaper still (USD 0.028 / 0.110 up to 32K input tokens, 0.083 / 0.330 up to 256K), so include it in the pilot. Arvan Gemma-4-31B-IT is far cheaper (USD 0.024 / 0.096) but quality is unproven.

answer.why: Lowest context tier USD 0.276 / 1.101. Quality for Persian and CS is unproven: decide in the 50-question pilot; switch to gemini-3.7-flash (AvalAI, 0.75 / 3.75) if the Persian slice fails.

judge-bulk.why: Different family from the Qwen answer model; USD 0.141 / 0.565 at idle hours (busy hours double). For about 75% of judge tokens (dev and bulk runs). The older deepseek-v4-flash on the same endpoint is flat USD 0.138 / 0.275 (no busy rate): check whether it judges as well.

judge-final.why: Stronger DeepSeek judge for the final claim-level and pairwise runs (about 25% of judge tokens), USD 1.65 / 3.301. Spot-check about 200 items with claude-haiku-4-5 (third family).

question-gen.why: Question generation and filtering with a family different from the answer model.

vision.why: Figure descriptions (optional ablation), USD 0.022 / 0.215 in the lowest tier.

embedding.why: Plan stays local bge-m3 and bge-reranker-v2-m3 (cost 0). If an API baseline is wanted, Arvan hosts bge-m3 at about USD 0.013 per 1M tokens; the best-listed API embedding otherwise is text-embedding-3-large at USD 0.13. Local use is the recommendation; the listed pick is the cheapest API equivalent.
